title: From Arizona IFR to 26,000 NM Pan-America! | MSFS 2024 Marketplace
description:
Looking to take your procedural flying, airline rotations, and visual exploration to the next level in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024? The Marketplace just rolled out an impressive wave of structured IFR flights, scheduled European airliner schedules, transcontinental road odysseys, and deep mountain gorge bush trips. Whether you want to sharpen your instrument procedures across the desert Southwest or hand-fly 26,000 nautical miles down the Americas, this week's drop delivers hours of purposeful flying!

In this activity breakdown, we organize the latest marketplace arrivals into clear categories to help you decide what's claiming top priority in your flight log:

✈️ PILOT TRAINING & COMMERCIAL OPERATIONS
We kick off with Perfect Flight’s Arizona IFR package for the Cessna 172 Skyhawk, delivering 12 structured IFR flights spanning challenging approaches into Sedona, Grand Canyon National Park, Phoenix Sky Harbor, and regional Arizona strips—complete with authentic audio, checklists, and route charts. Next, we look at ITY Summer 2026 for the iniBuilds Airbus A320neo v2, featuring an official ITA Airways livery and 12 realistic European airline rotation legs (including Rome to Zakynthos and Tripoli) backed by authentic sounds and over 100 monitored flight events.

🧭 SCENIC SIGHTSEEING & TRANSCONTINENTAL EXPEDITIONS
Ready for an unforgettable VFR journey? Perfect Flight presents Guided Tours New Zealand VFR, taking you across 12 scenic legs from volcanic peaks to the glaciated Southern Alps with over 250 narrated waypoints and tailored flight profiles. For endurance pilots, Koschi introduces the colossal Bundle PanAmericana: a 26,000 nautical mile odyssey retracing the world's longest road network from Deadhorse, Alaska to Ushuaia, Tierra del Fuego. We inspect its three continental legs, 10 discovery flights, and aircraft options including the Cessna 208B Grand Caravan and Pilatus PC-6.

🏞️ THE BEAUTIFUL CANYONS BUSH SERIES
For low-and-slow mountain flyers, Koschi releases the Beautiful Canyons Bundle (Parts 5 through 8). We explore four of the world's most dramatic gorges: Fish River Canyon in southern Namibia, the colossal Kali Gandaki and Yarlung Tsangpo in Asia, and the Tara River Canyon in Europe. We also look at the standalone releases vs. the complete discounted bundle option.

Which of these new activities are you loading up first? Flying instrument approaches into Sedona in the C172, flying scheduled Mediterranean routes in the ITA A320neo, or beginning the 26,000-mile journey down the Pan-American Highway? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you find your next flight adventure in MSFS 2024, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel for weekly sim coverage, and blue skies on your next flight!
